description: This file defines the WebUI component for Apache Spark's web interface, including classes for managing the server, tabs, pages, and handlers within the Spark UI.

classes.name: WebUI
classes.description: Abstract class representing the top-level web UI component managing server, tabs, pages, and handlers.

classes.name: WebUITab
classes.description: Abstract class representing a collection of pages within the WebUI, identified by a prefix.

classes.name: WebUIPage
classes.description: Abstract class representing a leaf page in the UI hierarchy, capable of rendering content.

classes.name: DelegatingServletContextHandler
classes.description: Wrapper class for ServletContextHandler providing methods to manipulate filters and context path.

methods.name: attachTab
methods.description: Attaches a WebUITab to the WebUI, including its pages.

methods.name: detachTab
methods.description: Detaches a WebUITab and its pages from the WebUI.

methods.name: attachPage
methods.description: Attaches a WebUIPage to the WebUI, creating handlers for rendering JSON and HTML.

methods.name: detachPage
methods.description: Detaches a WebUIPage and its handlers from the WebUI.

methods.name: attachHandler
methods.description: Attaches a ServletContextHandler to the server and the WebUI.

methods.name: attachHandler
methods.description: Overloaded method to attach a handler with a specific context path and servlet.

methods.name: detachHandler
methods.description: Detaches a specific ServletContextHandler from the WebUI.

methods.name: detachHandler
methods.description: Detaches a handler at a specific URI path.

methods.name: addStaticHandler
methods.description: Adds a static content handler to serve resources at a specified path.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to initialize UI components.

methods.name: initServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Jetty server for the WebUI.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the WebUI to the network, starting the server.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Checks if SSL is enabled for the server.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns 'https://' if SSL is enabled, otherwise 'http://'.

methods.name: webUrl
methods.description: Constructs the full URL of the WebUI.

methods.name: boundPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is bound to.
